quarterly_data.signal: ACM Shanghai's June 16, 2026 investor-relations record (Exhibit 99.1): based on current order trends and business momentum, ACM Shanghai continues to maintain its full-year 2026 revenue guidance of RMB 8.20 billion to RMB 8.80 billion, and expects to update its order backlog at the end of September.
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 revenue guidance RMB 8.20 billion to RMB 8.80 billion (maintained)

quarterly_data.signal: Electroplating systems represented approximately 30% of newly signed orders year-to-date in 2026. The high-temperature single-wafer SPM product, after several months of joint testing with major customers at the Lingang facility and demonstrating 15-nanometer particle-control performance, secured volume orders from multiple customers.
quarterly_data.figure: electroplating approximately 30% of newly signed orders YTD 2026

quarterly_data.signal: Lingang capacity: existing Plant A is operating close to full capacity; renovation of Plant B is scheduled to begin in the second half of 2026 with partial production lines targeted to become operational in the fourth quarter, and once Plants A and B are fully operational the combined annual output value is expected to reach approximately RMB 20 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: Plant A close to full capacity; Plants A and B combined annual output value approximately RMB 20 billion

quarterly_data.signal: ACM shipped its first PECVD SiCN system in April 2026 after pre-validation on the Lingang mini-line; it is at the customer's final qualification and targets back-end metal interconnect processes at the 55nm node and below. The Ultra LITH KrF Track system (300 WPH) was delivered to a leading Chinese logic wafer manufacturer in September 2025, with lithography-scanner integration expected in July 2026 and full production-process qualification expected by year-end.
quarterly_data.figure: first PECVD SiCN system shipped April 2026 (55nm and below); KrF Track scanner integration July 2026

quarterly_data.signal: ACM Shanghai's long-term revenue target is USD 4 billion, including USD 1.6 billion from overseas markets and USD 2.4 billion from mainland China; beyond its established South Korea operations it is exploring opportunities in Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam and Thailand.
quarterly_data.figure: long-term revenue target USD 4 billion (USD 1.6 billion overseas; USD 2.4 billion mainland China)

quarterly_data.signal: To mitigate semiconductor component price fluctuations, ACM Shanghai is increasing its use of domestically sourced components, diversifying supply channels and building inventory reserves; all non-standard components are now fully localized, with breakthroughs in localizing critical standard components including magnetic-drive pumps, heaters and filters.
